heard: David at Ziklag in the wilds, all the king kept him confined Men with bows and slings came near, from Benjamin they joined the field Haizer and Josh, the Shema sons from Gibeon Armed with shield and spear in hand, facing the battleground Their faces light the faces of lions, swift as gazelles on the mountains His mighty warriors in the fighting shields and spears held tight The Gaddaid men so brave Crossed the Jordan in the way Ezer the chief, Obadiah two, Eliab third in the crew crew. Nishman, the four, Jeremiah, five, the tie, six, with Elio's drive.
